cross_discipline_bridges.rationale: number sense supports money numeracy; the finance task still teaches domain-specific meaning
percent change supports interest and compounding calculations
rates and ratios support quantitative market interpretation
equations and inequalities support formal reasoning about conditions; not required for all beginner control flow
functions/graphs support selected web and data reasoning; not a universal HTTP prerequisite
problem decomposition is useful for turning broad interests into answerable research questions
search strategy supports independent investigation of networking concepts, not network operation
source credibility supports market/institution research
claim-evidence reasoning supports psychology as an evidence discipline
vocabulary acquisition helps formulate and refine searches across technical terminology
both involve writing; LANG focuses language production, COMM focuses purpose/audience effectiveness
audience and purpose inform information hierarchy
accessibility principles inform web/interface implementation
accessible document and communication tools need design awareness
functions and contracts inform automation design
both use version control; WORK focuses reliable workflow, ENG focuses engineering collaboration and history
terminal foundations and shell/Linux basics share command-line fluency but differ in security context and depth
privacy and digital safety inform secure/reliable software habits
units and circuit quantities apply ratio/rate reasoning
Ohm’s law uses algebraic rearrangement; teach algebra bridge when needed
measurement instruments require scale, unit and measurement reasoning
homeostasis and emotion regulation are distinct systems; bridge is comparison of regulation concepts, not equivalence
nervous system and attention can be connected through biological/psychological levels without reducing one to the other
sleep and recovery knowledge informs training-load decisions
exercise adaptation informs conditioning but is not a substitute for coaching or health advice
readiness and warm-up precede high-intensity speed work when appropriate
recovery/load interpretation informs training design
vocal health bounds breath practice
breath coordination supports pitch work while pitch can also be practised gently in parallel
both study visual perception; ART emphasises observation/drawing, AEST emphasises designed communication
value/light and colour foundations intersect but have distinct artistic and design aims
composition/framing principles transfer across design and fine-art composition
customer discovery and research question formation share inquiry but differ in evidence and ethics context
market research uses search strategy and source evaluation
bookkeeping and accounting foundations overlap; business operations context is distinct
unit economics require explicit uncertainty and risk interpretation
listening appears in both; COMM assesses communication technique, LEAD assesses team/leadership use
teamwork and feedback/disagreement connect in collaborative settings
project coordination uses planning and estimation
food safety and nutrition/digestion are distinct; one is safe handling, the other biological function
first-aid literacy and health information literacy meet at recognizing limits and seeking qualified help

gap_overlap_sequence_register.finding: Mathematical fluency is a hidden dependency across finance, electrical measurement, engineering and data work.
gap_overlap_sequence_register.treatment: Do not gate entire disciplines; attach local just-in-time diagnostic bridges to the exact calculation required.

gap_overlap_sequence_register.finding: Reading/listening comprehension and technical vocabulary affect every discipline but are not represented as universal prerequisites.
gap_overlap_sequence_register.treatment: Offer language support and glossary overlays; do not block entry based on language proficiency when equivalent evidence modes exist.

gap_overlap_sequence_register.finding: Digital file, privacy and account-safety foundations are prerequisites for safe evidence capture and app use.
gap_overlap_sequence_register.treatment: Provide an onboarding safety bridge; distinguish platform operation from subject competence.

gap_overlap_sequence_register.finding: Measurement, units, uncertainty and data interpretation are unevenly explicit across science/engineering/health modules.
gap_overlap_sequence_register.treatment: Add objective-level measurement and uncertainty checks where outcomes require them; do not insert a generic science gate.

gap_overlap_sequence_register.finding: Ethical reasoning, consent and privacy appear as boundaries but not as a consistent cross-disciplinary competency thread.
gap_overlap_sequence_register.treatment: Maintain discipline-specific safeguards and link to a common ethics/privacy reference layer.

gap_overlap_sequence_register.finding: No explicit universal data literacy module exists in the 216 spine despite use in research, business, finance and performance analysis.
gap_overlap_sequence_register.treatment: Treat as a proposed cross-disciplinary bridge/candidate module, not an invented 217th baseline record.

gap_overlap_sequence_register.finding: No explicit universal visual literacy bridge joins ART, AEST, diagrams, data visualisation and technical schematics.
gap_overlap_sequence_register.treatment: Use shared visual-analysis vocabulary while preserving domain-specific standards.

gap_overlap_sequence_register.finding: Accessibility is explicit in AEST but needs operational checks in documents, language tasks, apps, presentations and assessment delivery.
gap_overlap_sequence_register.treatment: Apply access-mode checks to all assessments without treating accessibility as an optional aesthetic extra.

gap_overlap_sequence_register.finding: ENG-009 Version control foundations and WORK-008 Git workflow.
gap_overlap_sequence_register.treatment: Keep both: WORK teaches reliable everyday Git workflow; ENG teaches engineering collaboration, review and change history. Cross-reference and avoid duplicated beginner Git lessons.

gap_overlap_sequence_register.finding: WORK-007 Terminal foundations and CYBER-007 Shell and Linux basics.
gap_overlap_sequence_register.treatment: Keep both: WORK teaches safe command-line literacy; CYBER teaches OS/security-specific command interpretation in authorised labs.

gap_overlap_sequence_register.finding: LANG-007 Writing foundations and COMM-007 Writing for purpose.
gap_overlap_sequence_register.treatment: Keep both: LANG teaches language construction; COMM teaches rhetorical purpose, audience and task fit.

gap_overlap_sequence_register.finding: ART-001 Observation and visual analysis and AEST-001 Visual perception.
gap_overlap_sequence_register.treatment: Keep both: ART trains observation for making; AEST applies perception to designed communication.

gap_overlap_sequence_register.finding: ART-006 Value and light and AEST-004 Colour foundations.
gap_overlap_sequence_register.treatment: Coordinate terminology, but do not merge artistic tonal rendering and design colour systems.

gap_overlap_sequence_register.finding: BIZ-008 Bookkeeping and cash flow and FIN-006 Accounting foundations.
gap_overlap_sequence_register.treatment: Keep both: FIN teaches general accounting concepts; BIZ applies records and cash movement to operations.

gap_overlap_sequence_register.finding: LEAD-003 Listening and understanding and COMM-002 Active listening.
gap_overlap_sequence_register.treatment: LEAD focuses team leadership use; COMM focuses observable listening behaviours and communication technique.

gap_overlap_sequence_register.finding: INDEP-004 Food safety and BODY-008 Nutrition and digestion.
gap_overlap_sequence_register.treatment: Do not conflate safe food handling with physiology/nutrition.

gap_overlap_sequence_register.finding: BODY-010 Exercise adaptation and ATH-011 Training design.
gap_overlap_sequence_register.treatment: BODY explains physiological adaptation; ATH applies training design with safety and load management.

gap_overlap_sequence_register.finding: RES-003 Source credibility and CYBER-011 Defensive monitoring (signals vs evidence).
gap_overlap_sequence_register.treatment: Use shared evidence reasoning; keep cyber monitoring operational and bounded to authorised systems.

gap_overlap_sequence_register.finding: The existing graph contains 206 advisory edges, mostly within-discipline progression.
gap_overlap_sequence_register.treatment: Keep sequence advisory. Review cross-discipline entry points via diagnostic placement; no hard prerequisites are introduced by this wave.

gap_overlap_sequence_register.finding: MATH has 19 edges while most other disciplines have 11; this is a denser internal path.
gap_overlap_sequence_register.treatment: Preserve math-specific sequence pending subject review; do not infer the extra edges as universal dependencies.

representative_learner_pathways.name: Academic and scientific foundations
representative_learner_pathways.outcome: Build quantitative, evidence and explanation foundations that support later formal study.
representative_learner_pathways.entry_rule: Start from diagnostic evidence, not age or assumed school level.

representative_learner_pathways.name: Builder and engineer
representative_learner_pathways.outcome: Move from problem framing to safe, testable digital/physical prototypes.
representative_learner_pathways.entry_rule: Electrical and cybersecurity practical work remains safety-gated by environment and authorisation.

representative_learner_pathways.name: Product and business builder
representative_learner_pathways.outcome: Validate a real problem, shape an offer, manage basic money and communicate honestly.
representative_learner_pathways.entry_rule: Use fictional/anonymised cases and guardian/professional support for legal or financial commitments.

representative_learner_pathways.name: Creative maker
representative_learner_pathways.outcome: Develop observation, craft, composition, critique and purposeful communication.
representative_learner_pathways.entry_rule: Portfolio quality is judged against the selected medium and brief, not one universal aesthetic.

representative_learner_pathways.name: Independent life capability
representative_learner_pathways.outcome: Build safe, reliable everyday systems and know when to seek adult or professional help.
representative_learner_pathways.entry_rule: Higher-risk tasks are simulations or supervised demonstrations.

representative_learner_pathways.name: Athletic and performance development
representative_learner_pathways.outcome: Understand movement, practice safely, monitor recovery and refine performance.
representative_learner_pathways.entry_rule: No maximal testing or pain-based progression; qualified coaching/clinical input when indicated.

representative_learner_pathways.name: Research and critical thinking
representative_learner_pathways.outcome: Ask answerable questions, evaluate evidence and produce traceable conclusions.
representative_learner_pathways.entry_rule: Research involving people requires consent, privacy protection and appropriate adult/ethics oversight.

representative_learner_pathways.name: Communication and leadership
representative_learner_pathways.outcome: Communicate clearly, coordinate work and handle disagreement ethically.
representative_learner_pathways.entry_rule: Use role-play or consented collaboration; do not infer character from a single interaction.
